title: Shape Accelerator
content:
Shape Accelerator is a cutting-edge financial growth platform built to help businesses scale faster with data-driven investment strategies. Jagha Global was brought in to completely overhaul their digital presence — taking them from an outdated, low-converting website to a high-performance platform that commands trust in the competitive finance sector.

Our team conducted a full audit of their brand positioning, user journey, and SEO footprint. We rebuilt the website from the ground up with conversion-first architecture, a refined visual identity, and a content strategy targeting high-intent finance keywords. The result was a 340% increase in organic traffic within 90 days and a 47% reduction in bounce rate — turning passive visitors into qualified leads.

Through performance marketing campaigns and smart SEO, Shape Accelerator now dominates search results for their core service keywords. The new platform continues to grow month-over-month, delivering consistent ROI and cementing their reputation as a leading growth partner in the finance industry.

The Challenge Of Project

  • Establishing credibility in a competitive finance market with a brand that looks modern, authoritative, and trustworthy.
  • Optimizing the conversion funnel to capture high-value leads from targeted paid search and organic channels.
  • Building a scalable digital infrastructure that supports long-term growth without requiring a full redesign every year.

title: TSC
content:
TSC Group is a full-service business consulting firm helping mid-market companies navigate growth, restructuring, and digital transformation. When they approached Jagha Global, their brand was fragmented — inconsistent visuals, a slow website, and zero digital presence in key markets. They needed a complete identity overhaul backed by a strategic digital marketing plan.

Jagha Global delivered a cohesive brand system — new logo, typography, color palette, and brand guidelines — paired with a fast, beautifully designed website and a targeted SEO and content strategy. Within four months, TSC Group saw a 210% increase in inbound inquiries and ranked on page one for 18 high-value consulting keywords in their regional market.

The new TSC brand now positions them as a premium consulting partner — with a digital presence that reflects their expertise and consistently attracts the right clients across organic, referral, and paid channels.

The Challenge Of Project

  • Creating a unified brand identity that reflects TSC's expertise across multiple consulting verticals.
  • Building digital authority from scratch in a saturated consulting market dominated by large legacy firms.
  • Developing a lead generation system that attracts qualified decision-makers rather than generic traffic.

title: Onyxio
content:
Onyxio is a premium pet care e-commerce brand that sells specialist nutrition and wellness products. Despite a quality product range, they were invisible online — losing customers to competitors with stronger branding and better-optimized stores. Jagha Global was tasked with a complete brand and digital overhaul.

We crafted a bold, memorable brand identity for Onyxio — warm, trusted visuals that connect emotionally with pet owners — and rebuilt their e-commerce store with a focus on UX, mobile performance, and conversion. We layered in targeted performance marketing campaigns on Meta and Google, along with SEO-optimized product and category pages. Within six months, Onyxio's monthly revenue grew by 280% and their return customer rate doubled.

The Onyxio transformation is a clear example of what happens when great branding meets data-driven marketing — a business that went from struggling for visibility to becoming the go-to name in their niche, with a loyal customer base and a scalable digital engine behind every sale.

The Challenge Of Project

  • Differentiating a new e-commerce brand in a crowded pet care market dominated by established retailers.
  • Achieving a profitable ROAS on paid campaigns while simultaneously growing organic search presence.
  • Designing a seamless mobile-first shopping experience that reduces cart abandonment and maximizes AOV.
